The '''1992–93 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 57th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 5 September 1992 and ended on 6 June 1993. [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] won their second consecutive and tenth Greek title. This was the first season in which the new points system was introduced ''(Win: 3 points - Draw: 1 point - Loss: 0 points)'', replacing the corresponding 2–1–0 and remained as it is since then.
